The user wants to know if the application automatically detects when the LSP (Language Server Protocol) process crashes or becomes unresponsive and restarts it without user intervention.

I have three completed jobs (T1, T2, T3) that investigated this.
T1 looked for where the crash is detected and restart triggered. Found `restart lsp for workspace`, `schedule debounced lsp restart`.
T2 looked for the event/signal detecting the crash and calling the restart function. Found `ensure ready`, `start completion server`, `ensure completion server`, `health ok`.
T3 looked for where the LSP unresponsiveness is detected and restart triggered. Found `lsp client cpp`, `schedule debounced lsp restart`, `wait response`, `reader loop`, `restart lsp for workspace`, `start`, `on transport reader eof`, `run`.

The "Cerrado" sections for all three jobs state: "ESA pregunta no se relanza. Lo leído no era el disparo. PROHIBIDO el mismo claim. do=cerrar ese mapeo."
